notes.title: Phantom Hysteria - Patch 1.2.1
notes.content:
[b][h1]Updates[/h1][/b]

[list]
[*] Implemented equipment pegboards on all maps, improving equipment discovery efficiency.
[*] Updated Yugo's textures to a higher resolution.
[*] Introduced a cross-progression screen catering to new players. This is for players who will be wanting to carry over their progress across all platforms Phantom Hysteria will be released on. Returning players can effortlessly log into their existing accounts by selecting "Yes," whereas selecting "No" will lock your progress to Steam only. (If you select no, this will create a new Account and you will lose all current progress.)
[*] Incorporated shirt and jacket cosmetic slots in preparation for future vanity items.
[*] Added an FOV slider to the Options menu.
[*] Substituted the Arpa Warehouse catwalk with a storage area for enhanced gameplay.
[*] Players now spawn in the training area in P.I.N.E HQ.
[/list]

[b][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that could sometimes cause a high pitched audio screeching.
[*] Resolved a bug causing players to lose control of their characters when being teleported by Morrigan.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused players to lose control of their character if the phantom execution failed.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the Padded Stock arcana card to not work as intended and has now been updated to only increase the damage of salt-based weapons by 5%.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused some in-game badges to be given to all players in a lobby rather than just the player that initiated the action.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused some match related badges to not be rewarded to players if they played on Arpa Warehouse.
[/list]

notes.title: Phantom Hysteria - Patch v1.2.0 - Horror Harmony
notes.content:
Welcome to the Horror Harmony update!

[b][h1]New Features[/h1][/b]

[list]
[*] Updated all UI menus to be controller accessible.
[*] Introduced in-game badge achievements.
[*] Added Steam achievements for enhanced gaming experience.
[*] New map: ARPA Warehouse
[*] Implemented an aim assist system supporting both controller and Mouse/Keyboard.
[*] Added the Dynamic Controller Sensitive system to enhance gameplay control.
[/list]
[b][h1]Updates
[/h1][/b]
[list]
[*] Revamped HUD icon visuals for improved clarity.
[*] Phone is now the primary menu widget and is opened by "Escape" or "Gamepad Start" buttons by default
[*] Adaptive HUD button icons that change based on input method (Controller or Keyboard/Mouse).
[*] Refreshed design and animation of the new Arcana Card.
[*] Revamped the Training area in HQ (Look forward to the upcoming Firing Range!).
[*] General VFX optimization pass
[*] Refined card mechanics: stacks are now removed upon activation and disabled when depleted.
[*] Altered card mechanics to only eliminate slots locked behind new class selection levels.
[*] Implemented a phantom post-process effect upon taking damage, which enhances visibility when shot.
[*] Updated vanity grids for improved aesthetics, featuring accurate display names and updated skin images.
[*] Added "lock" icons to the HUD for locked class abilities, providing clear progression goals.
[*] Refreshed the Monitor model in HQ for a more immersive experience.
[*] Improved Snake mini game performance
[*] Removed EMF Barriers on all maps
[/list]
[b][h1]Equipment and Gadget Updates[/h1][/b]

[list]
[*] Enlarged the player's chest flashlight for better visibility.
[*] Spirit box now fully operational with all pings.
[*] Extended Cross energy duration to last continuously for 20 seconds.
[*] Optimized adrenal shot mechanics: increased healing potency to 20, speed boost decreased to 10%, stamina regen raised to 3 per tick, and buff duration extended to 45 seconds.
[/list]

[b][h1]Sound Changes[/h1][/b]

[list]
[*] Eliminated noise triggers associated with dropping items and reduced noise chance for walking steps.
[*] Rectified RTCP issues to ensure UI sounds are clear and undistorted.
[/list]

[b][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][/b]

- Rectified an issue when petting Harold that previously triggered the Low Health filter.
- Resolved problem preventing players from seeing after experiencing a second death after being revived.
- Fixed Issue prohibiting players from reviving deceased teammates.

notes.title: Patch Notes: 1.1.0 Phantom Hysteria Cleansing Fire Update
notes.content:
[h1][b]New Features[/b][/h1]

[list]
[*]  New Phantom character, "Nurse Redcliffe" 
[*]  New Phantom model transparency update
[*]  Phantom executions and interaction animations are now all in first person
[*]  New AI target acquisition system that relies on sight and sound to attack
[*]  Phantom AI now have a harder time hearing and seeing players that are crouched
[*]  Glowsticks can reveal hunting phantoms in their light
[/list]

[h1]Equipment Updates[/h1]

[h3]New hand held flashlight equipment item[/h3]
[list]
[*]High powered flashlight takes up an equipment slot and has a battery that runs down with use
[/list]
[h3]Update to "UV light" equipment item[/h3]
[list]
[*] UV light now has a battery that runs down with use
[/list]
[h3]Chestlight[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now has a small random chance to malfunction and dim, requiring to be turned off and back on to fix
[/list]
[h3]Spirit Box[/h3]
[list]
[*] The spiritbox can now sometimes pick up on phantom voices (these voices DO NOT count as spiritbox evidence) and now uses phantom character voicelines for evidence. Spiritbox evidence type only occurs if the phantom RESPONDS to you talking to it. There will also be a flashing ghost icon on the spiritbox to indicate a phantom response
[/list]

[h1]Class Updates[/h1]
[h2]Shaman[/h2]
[list]
[*] Player class "Shaman" new level 0 passive "Nature Tuned": Reduced stamina loss and can hear unbanished phantoms
[/list]


[h1]General Updates[/h1]

[list]
[*] Player spawn points moved to saferooms and game now starts when all players move from spawn point
[*] Phantom Hunt alert sound effects removed so phantom hunts are no longer announced or obvious
[*] Added random "Tips" to server travel screen
[*] Added fade out and fade in when a player dies and becomes a ghost themselves
[*] Added AI "Stalking" feature during investigation phase
[*] New UI updates for player bars and phantom health bar that includes cutaway damage animation
[*] New UI "debuff" screen animations for burn damage over time effects
[*] Some new cosmetic hats added to in game store
[*]Phantom voices can no longer be heard globally pre-banishment
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed issue where the "Survivor", "Flak Jacket", and "Don't Cross the Streams" arcana cards were not working as intended
[*] Fixed issue where phantom would sometimes disappear for long periods of time
[*] Fixed issue where dead players could move around while on the ground
[*] Fixed issue where phantom subtitles would sometimes be wrong
[*] Fixed issue where item animations were delayed for clients resulting in a sluggish feeling
[*] Fixed issue where the toilets would sometimes continue to flush
[*] Fixed issue preventing some players from logging in
[*] Fixed issue preventing the use of some phone buttons
[*] Fixed issue that sometimes punished players for guessing the entity type correctly
[*] Fixed issue that cause Lucas to try to attack players through walls
[/list]

notes.title: Game Update
notes.content:
While not a new version update, we have decided to push changes from the current beta version to live!  Most of these changes include improvements to the current in-game voice chat, as well as some quality of life and accessibility updates.


[h1]Gameplay Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Vivox integration
[*]Text-to-speech for text chat
[*]New option in contacts section on phone to mute other players
[*]New option in contacts section on phone to deafen yourself
[*]Push-to-talk is available in the audio settings
[*]Can now select device to use for VOIP in audio settings
[*]Added volume slider for player mic adjustments
[*]Added visual indicator when local player is muted or deafened
[*]Added visual indicator when player is speaking
[/list]

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Morrigan and Molly can now cleave with slash attacks
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]"Coolant Tank" and "Don't Cross the Streams" Arcana cards fixed
[*]Match result screen should properly display XP, Ducats, and Ash received
[*]Fixed Morrigan's locomotion to be smoother
[*]Fixed issue where Phantom swipes would inconsistently connect with crouched players
[*]Disabled Oculus and OpenXR due to issues with users with Oculus tracking causing long load times
[/list]

notes.title: Phantom Hysteria v.1.0.0.0 Release Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Major Updates[/h1]

[h2]Cross Progression Integration[/h2]
[list]
[*]When starting up Phantom Hysteria for the first time, you will now be asked to create an account with Lunar Tale Games.  This is being integrated as future proofing for release on different platforms.  You will have to set up a username and password, but once Phantom Hysteria is on any other platform, all you will have to do to continue your current progress is log in!
[/list]

[h2]Composure[/h2]
[list]
[*]Composure as a mechanic has been removed from the game.  We felt that it didn't add anything of value to the core gameplay.  As such, there are a few changes!  Arcana cards involving the composure mechanic have been removed from the game.  Composure shots have been reworked  into adrenal shots.  All class abilities involving composure have been removed or reworked.
[/list]

[h2]Class Reworks[/h2]
[list]
[*]Due to the removal of composure as well as some feedback from our beta testers, we wanted to make sure that all classes felt useful.
[list]
[h3]Scholar[/h3]
[list]
[*]Scholar's level 10 active ability has been reworked into "The Invisible Man".  This ability makes the player invisible to the phantom for a short period of time with a cooldown of 60 seconds.
[*]The level 15 passive ability "Shots" has been updated to increase the effectiveness of Adrenal Shots rather than Composure Shots.
[*]"Land Mines", the level 40 passive ability, has been updated to starting a match with an EMF Mine waiting for you in the Equipment Room.
[*]The second active ability at level 50 has been fully reworked.  "It's Miller Time!" will allow players to instantly reload or recharge their current weapon with a cooldown of 60 seconds.
[/list]
[h3]Attuned[/h3]
[list]
[*]The first active ability on Attuned has been reworked as "Life Steal".  At level 10, players can now activate this ability to take 10% of the phantom's health to heal themselves.
[*]The level 15 passive has been reworked as "Oh a Clue!" which will allow players to see the trail of the phantom periodically.
[*]Attuned's level 30 passive is now "Second Wind" which will regenerate health while the player is not in combat.
[*]The second active ability has been reworked as "Last Stand".  This makes the player invulnerable for 60 seconds as a one time use in a match.
[/list]
[h3]Neutralizer[/h3]
[list]
[*]The level 40 passive has been reworked.  "Salty" allows players to deal 5% more damage with salt-based weapons.
[/list]
[h3]Shaman[/h3]
[list]
[*]Shaman's level 10 active ability has been reworked as "I Got You Covered".  With this, the player is able to give themselves or another player a temporary shield that reduces damage from the phantom on a cooldown of 60 seconds.
[*]"Unwavering" is Shaman's new level 40 passive.  Once a player drops below 50% health, the next hit from a phantom will heal them for the amount of damage dealt.  This passive only activates once per match.
[*]The second active ability, "Living Dead", has been updated so that players must now sacrifice a portion of their health in order to revive a teammate.  The resurrected teammate will now come back with 50% of their health.
[/list]
[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]The pull damage per second from Molly's ultimate has been reduced from 3 to 1
[*]Phantoms will now regenerate their health during Neutralization phase if the players have voted for the incorrect ghost
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]More Spirit Box responses
[*]Subtitles have been implemented and can be toggled on and off in the Settings menu
[*]Added custom cursors for all weapons
[*]Added custom cursor for hovering over interactables
[*]Added shockwave and audio tuning to phantom defeated sequence
[*]Added dissolve effect on destroyed totems
[*]Added dissolve effect on destroyed runes
[*]Added visual effect when statue is combined
[*]Updated player flashlight to be a little more visible
[*]Added health loss post-process system
[*]Updated UI elements
[*]Added contacts listing on phone where you can mute other players in your match
[*]Added an editable text box to the sensitivity sliders in the Settings menu
[*]CHADDEV has been removed as a playable investigator (to be added as an unlockable at a future date)
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Updated player wallet and loadout to be more reliable between matches
[*]Fixed animation cancel bug for clients
[*]Added stack limit on phantom debuffs on player to prevent overlap and effect spam
[*]Fixed issue with phantom death sequence effect not spawning in the correct location for clients
[/list]

[h1]KIWI TIME![/h1]
[list]
[*][Redacted] Kiwi now causes him to [redacted] with [redacted]
[/list]

[h1]Sound Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added RTPC for character narration volume
[/list]

[h1]Gadget Tuning[/h1]
[list]
[h2]Adrenal Shots[/h2]
[list]
[*]Composure shots have been reworked as adrenal shots that provide a temporary speed boost, stamina regen boost, and a small heal
[/list]
[h2]Holy Water[/h2]
[list]
[*]Holy water has been updated to debuff the phantom's movement speed over 30 seconds, stackable up to 3 times
[/list]
[h2]Cross[/h2]
[list]
[*]The cross has been updated to have an active ability that is used to repel the phantoms at close range from players, losing durability as it's used
[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Weapon Tuning[/h1]
[list]
[*]All weapon effects converted to gas via gameplay cues
[*]Shotgun now ejects shells
[*]Fixed shotgun animations to appear smoother
[*]Fixed EMFG line trace
[*]Holy Soaker projectiles shoot a little faster
[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*]Dropping weapons has been temporarily disabled as we continue to work towards fixing a bug causing issues when picking up another player's weapon
[*]Shotgun spray effect not replicating properly
[/list]


You've all been asking for it!  You can now pet Harold at Headquarters!
